correctness.rationale: The explicit mod-3 coefficient identity is exact. Q is a smooth conic with exactly four F3 points; these give the four displayed tangent lines. Smoothness, Bezout and the dual-conic no-three-collinear argument give precisely four double contacts plus six distinct nodes over the algebraic closure. The complete local models uv and u(u-v^2) yield delta=1,2 and Tjurina lengths 1,3, so the geometric totals are 14 and 18. The genus formula agrees with the plane sextic genus 10. The five rational P1 components and ten rational pairwise intersections give N_(3^r)=5*3^r-5 for every positive r by inclusion–exclusion, whence the stated zeta function. A standalone checker confirms polynomial coefficients and all F3 incidence assertions; it is not used as proof of geometric completeness.

value.rationale: The bad-characteristic fibre of a natural classical genus-six plane model has a complete, nontrivial geometric classification: every rational tangent of the conic appears, four pre-existing node locations become tacnodes, six extra nodes form the complete tangent-pair incidence, and exact normalization/Jacobian defects and the full finite-field zeta function of the special fibre are determined. It is a natural boundary invariant and a concrete starting point for arithmetic model studies, not a contrived subfamily or mere finite-field count.
